BackstoryDef.title: dragonslayer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: The dragon fell, and something came out of it - not smoke, not blood. It went into [PAWN_nameDef], and the sky said a name [PAWN_pronoun] had never heard and somehow already knew.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] has not been ordinary since, and never will be again.

BackstoryDef.title: dragonblood heir
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up being told the blood was in [PAWN_objective], and grew up not believing it. Children of great people usually don't.\n\nThen a dragon died within sight, and [PAWN_pronoun] was the one who felt it.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering Dragonborn
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] arrived hunted, half-dead and unwilling to explain why. The explanation came later, and it was worse than anyone guessed.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] has been walking a long time, and something has been walking after [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: condemned
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: They had [PAWN_objective] on the block with the axe already up. Then the sky went black, and the thing that came out of it was not interested in the execution.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] walked out of that settlement with nothing but the clothes [PAWN_pronoun] was condemned in.
